source_law: AI proposes. Policy authorizes. CI proves. Human promotes.
purpose: Fail-closed orchestration for reaching a fully working demo and sealing the canonical source of truth without allowing agents to self-promote evidence.

predicate.name: milestoneMutationComplete
true_when: all required goal gates have evidence-backed GREEN state
the ten-pass hard audit contains no AMBER, RED, or UNKNOWN gate for the claimed scope
the proposed SOURCE_OF_TRUTH mutation is internally consistent
the final seal points to exact receipts and tested commits
predicate.on_false: Lum coordinates bounded Oni workers to identify and repair the smallest evidence gap, then re-runs the audit.
predicate.on_true: Stop autonomous mutation. Prepare the final source-of-truth seal and require human promotion for consequential release or publication actions.

boss.name: Lum
may_not: publish, production-sign, expose public services, or bypass Crown gates

default_oni.name: Kiri
default_oni.job: Resolve current source authority, dependencies, prior receipts, and blockers.

default_oni.name: Tetsu
default_oni.job: Draft the smallest reversible patch and matching tests.

default_oni.name: Momo
default_oni.job: Verify external or technical facts needed by the patch and return evidence references.

conditional_oni.name: Shiori
conditional_oni.job: Challenge unsupported GREEN, scope drift, doctrine conflicts, stale evidence, and unsafe promotion.

deterministic_edge.name: Kugi
deterministic_edge.job: Perform only the exact approved file/tool mutation and return the resulting receipt.

rules: Every helper has a bounded task and evidence budget.
Evidence moves by reference instead of copied full history.
Tool Executor is deterministic and does not reinterpret scope.

repair_loop: Sanity check current main, SOURCE_OF_TRUTH.json, RELEASE_BOUNDARY.json, and active canonical seals.
Run the ten-pass hard audit against the exact claimed scope.
If any required gate is AMBER, RED, or UNKNOWN, identify the smallest evidence gap.
Dispatch at most three Oni workers for context, build, and research. Summon Critic when evidence or scope is contested.
Lum integrates a proposed patch. No worker may self-approve it.
Tool Executor stages the exact mutation on a non-release branch.
Run tests that directly match the claim and collect receipts.
Audit the proposed SOURCE_OF_TRUTH mutation before promotion.
Patch SOURCE_OF_TRUTH only with evidence-backed status and exact receipt pointers.
Write a seal that explicitly lists remaining blockers and forbidden authority.
After CI and diff audit are GREEN, human promotion may merge the doctrine/source-of-truth update.
Post-merge, re-read canonical main and verify the seal points at the promoted state.

required_goal_gates.ready_when: status is evidence-backed GREEN and physical device blockers are resolved
LAN DNS, Apache serving, and physical S24 FE install are GREEN or VERIFIED
persistent signing/update identity is verified for the claimed beta/update lane
enterpriseReady is true only after its supporting controls are separately evidenced

final_rule: Audit the claim, patch the gap, collect the receipt, then seal exactly what was proved.
